events.text: The fortress of Izmail was built by Genoese merchants.
events.subject: self
events.quote: The fortress of Izmail was built by Genoese merchants in the 12th century

events.text: Izmail belonged for a short period of time to Wallachia.
events.subject: self
events.quote: It belonged for a short period of time to Wallachia ( 14th century )

events.text: Izmail was under the rule of Moldavia.
events.subject: self
events.quote: From the end of the 14th century , Izmail was under the rule of Moldavia

events.text: The Ottoman state conquered the territory.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1484 , the Ottoman state conquered the territory

events.text: The territory came under direct rule.
events.subject: self

events.text: Sultan Selim II settled Izmail with his Nogai subjects.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1569 Sultan Selim II settled Izmail with his Nogai subjects

events.text: Russian general Nicholas Repnin took the fortress of Izmail.
events.subject: self
events.quote: After Russian general Nicholas Repnin took the fortress of Izmail in 1770

events.subject: self
events.quote: Alexander Suvorov successfully stormed it on 22 December 1790

events.text: Suvorov announced the capture of Ismail to the Empress Catherine.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Suvorov announced the capture of Ismail in 1791 to the Empress Catherine

events.text: Russian forces took Izmail for the third time.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Russian forces took it for the third time on 14 September 1809

events.text: Izmail was ceded to Russia with the rest of Bessarabia by the Treaty of Bucharest.
events.subject: self
events.quote: After it was ceded to Russia with the rest of Bessarabia by the 1812 Treaty of Bucharest

events.text: The Intercession Cathedral dates back to that time.

events.text: The city was occupied by the Romanian Army.
